name: Explorers of Palan
storyline:
Surrounded by woods and vegetation, Palan is home to restless creatures seeking battles.

But of course, this kingdom also has coastline. You can even collect Shells on the beach.

There are also rocky tunnels waiting to be explored. When you find a fragile wall, break it with your Hammer to uncover a tunnel entrance.

Butterflies can be found in various places — if you manage to touch them, they share Pollen with your companion Feyrie. Believe it, Pollen is useful!

There’s more to explore than what’s been said here. Now, put on your Royal Explorer outfit and experience everything Explorers of Palan has to offer!
summary: Battle in turns: Gain EXP to become stronger with each victory as you calm agitated creatures. Defeated in battle? Don’t worry — besides recovery skills and items, your companion Feyrie can restore you.
